caption: Tivoli Christmas, Copenhagen
composition: Chinese Tower across the Tivoli lake, Christmas huts on the near bank · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: From the east bank of the Tivoli lake, the multi-tier Chinese Tower stands on the far shore, each upturned eave lined with warm bulbs and reflected in the dark water. Wooden Christmas huts with a thin snow dusting line the near bank, and bare trees carry strings of warm light. The sky is mostly cloudy. The cold, the cloud, and the light dusting are a seasonal artistic interpretation of an evening, about 3.3°C, not a December forecast. No readable sign.
alt_text: AI-generated artistic interpretation of Tivoli Gardens in Copenhagen on a Christmas evening, the Chinese Tower reflected in the lake
